name: Aurelia Transit Utilities
description: Quality-of-life tools for Minecraft Transit Railway: train presets for sidings, drag-and-drop route stop ordering, bulk platform dwell times and a station-overlap resolver, plus an Announcer for the MTR train you ride and settings published to Joban Client Mod vehicle scripts. Also makes MTR trains cheaper to draw (fewer draw calls, faster with shader packs). Client-side, no new blocks. Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with MTR.
